what: B: Go to their door (A's), steps off it, N, leaves a note on A's land

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const P = (await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts')).samplePlayer(); return JSON.stringify({ p: P && [Math.round(P.x*10)/10, Math.round(P.z*10)/10], visiting: P?.visiting ?? P?.tag ?? null, chunk: S.useEngineStore.getState().chunk, layers: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer]')].map(l => l.getAttribute('data-layer')) }) })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=notes]') ?? document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 800) : 'no notes layer: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer]')].map(x => x.getAttribute('data-layer')).join(',') })()

(() => { const f = document.querySelector('[data-layer=notes] textarea') ?? document.querySelector('[data-layer=notes] input'); if (!f) return 'no field'; f.focus(); return document.activeElement === f })()

actions.type: Bea from the next world over: your windmill field is lovely at dusk.
